test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'Forlon'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word is Forlon.
 
• 
 Let us explore the **meaning **of the given options

 
 
• **Forlon **- There is no such word in English or we can say that there is a spelling mistake in the word. 
 
• Feign - pretend to be affected by (a feeling, state, or injury).
 
• Fascinate - attract the strong attention and interest of (someone).
 
• Forfeit - lose or be deprived of (property or a right or privilege) as a penalty for wrongdoing; a fine or penalty for wrongdoing.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If we add the letter r in the word forlon before **n,** we get the word correct word i.e. FORLORN.
 
• Forlorn is a proper English word and it means "**pitifully sad and abandoned or lonely."**
